summary.availability_policy: All predictors are available at scoring/origin time; past targets enter only after outcome time.

calendar_volume.availability: Computed at incident opening from the current opening record or strictly prior events/outcomes.
calendar_volume.missing_behavior: Categorical absence is an explicit level; numeric absence is fold-fitted median imputation.
calendar_volume.mechanism: Opening calendar plus D-1/D-7 and left-shifted rolling incident volumes proxy operating regime.
calendar_volume.leakage_analysis: All lags and rolling windows end before the opening date; current-day total is excluded.

sparse_categories.availability: Computed at incident opening from the current opening record or strictly prior events/outcomes.
sparse_categories.missing_behavior: Categorical absence is an explicit level; numeric absence is fold-fitted median imputation.
sparse_categories.mechanism: Fold-fitted one-hot identity represents additive opening classification effects without ordinal assumptions.
sparse_categories.leakage_analysis: Vocabulary is fitted only on pre-month training rows; unknown levels are ignored.

historical_backoff.availability: Computed at incident opening from the current opening record or strictly prior events/outcomes.
historical_backoff.missing_behavior: Categorical absence is an explicit level; numeric absence is fold-fitted median imputation.
historical_backoff.mechanism: Smoothed violation history and support for product/category/subcategory using outcomes known before each opening.
historical_backoff.leakage_analysis: Target appears only in strictly prior known outcomes; current/future outcomes are excluded by event-time search.

novelty_missingness.availability: Computed at incident opening from the current opening record or strictly prior events/outcomes.
novelty_missingness.missing_behavior: Categorical absence is an explicit level; numeric absence is fold-fitted median imputation.
novelty_missingness.mechanism: Prior support and first-seen indicators expose unfamiliar classifications while preserving informative missingness.
novelty_missingness.leakage_analysis: Support uses only prior openings; simultaneous/current rows are left-open excluded.

fold_safe_encoded_categories.availability: Computed at incident opening from the current opening record or strictly prior events/outcomes.
fold_safe_encoded_categories.missing_behavior: Categorical absence is an explicit level; numeric absence is fold-fitted median imputation.
fold_safe_encoded_categories.mechanism: Code, frequency, and smoothed target encodings make categories usable by tree models.
fold_safe_encoded_categories.leakage_analysis: Maps are fitted inside each outer fold; training target encodings are leave-one-out.
fold_safe_encoded_categories.ablation_result: Evaluated as part of a model-family cycle; no clean one-factor isolation

word_tfidf.availability: Computed at incident opening from the current opening record or strictly prior events/outcomes.
word_tfidf.missing_behavior: Categorical absence is an explicit level; numeric absence is fold-fitted median imputation.
word_tfidf.mechanism: Word unigrams/bigrams capture recurring alert and incident-summary templates.
word_tfidf.leakage_analysis: Vocabulary/IDF are fitted only on training rows; no vocabulary or raw text is persisted.
word_tfidf.ablation_result: Evaluated as part of a model-family cycle; no clean one-factor isolation

char_tfidf.availability: Computed at incident opening from the current opening record or strictly prior events/outcomes.
char_tfidf.missing_behavior: Categorical absence is an explicit level; numeric absence is fold-fitted median imputation.
char_tfidf.mechanism: Character 3-5 grams capture morphological variants and fragmented machine identifiers.
char_tfidf.leakage_analysis: Fold-local vocabulary; no raw token output.

naive_bayes_log_count_ratio.availability: Computed at incident opening from the current opening record or strictly prior events/outcomes.
naive_bayes_log_count_ratio.missing_behavior: Categorical absence is an explicit level; numeric absence is fold-fitted median imputation.
naive_bayes_log_count_ratio.mechanism: Training-only class-conditional ratios reweight binary word/character counts before logistic fitting.
naive_bayes_log_count_ratio.leakage_analysis: Ratios use training labels only and are recomputed for every outer fold.

fixed_rank_hybrid.availability: Computed at incident opening from the current opening record or strictly prior events/outcomes.
fixed_rank_hybrid.missing_behavior: Categorical absence is an explicit level; numeric absence is fold-fitted median imputation.
fixed_rank_hybrid.mechanism: Predeclared equal-weight fold-local ranks combine independent text and safe structured error patterns.
fixed_rank_hybrid.leakage_analysis: Weights are fixed before evaluation; no outer-fold labels tune blending.

risk.temporally_uncertain_group_policy: Grupo designado is used only by the reconstructed champion, never by challengers.

weekly_aligned_lags.mechanism: same target weekday at t-7/t-14/t-21 plus origin and long lags
weekly_aligned_lags.availability: target calendar plus y values at or before origin
weekly_aligned_lags.leakage: all referenced timestamps are asserted <= origin
weekly_aligned_lags.missing_behavior: rolling 28-day median fallback before sufficient history

trend_residual.mechanism: past slopes, changes, and seasonal-baseline residual summaries
trend_residual.leakage: residual baselines use only dates before each residual target

calendar_fourier.mechanism: weekday/month/week cycles, month-end, weekend and known holiday flags

fold_safe_synthetic_augmentation.mechanism: aligned seven-day block bootstrap of training-prefix real totals with 8% multiplicative noise
fold_safe_synthetic_augmentation.leakage: source restricted to real prefix; supplied synthetic rows excluded
fold_safe_synthetic_augmentation.missing_behavior: unseen target months fall back to aligned blocks from available months

year_end_operational_window.mechanism: Dec 24-31 weekdays share the causally learned earlier-weekday-holiday volume factor
year_end_operational_window.availability: window known; factor uses holidays observed by origin
year_end_operational_window.leakage: no future actual enters factor; operational assumption is explicit
year_end_operational_window.missing_behavior: factor 1.0 until a past weekday holiday exists; factor guarded to [0.35, 0.75]

lag_levels.mechanism: Recent and seasonal observed workload persistence.
lag_levels.leakage: Positive shifts only; target-day count excluded.
lag_levels.missing: Median imputation fitted in each training fold.

rolling_distribution.mechanism: Robust recent workload level, dispersion, and weekday capacity proxy.
rolling_distribution.leakage: Every rolling input shifted by one; same-weekday windows shift one group observation.
rolling_distribution.missing: Minimum histories enforced; fold-fitted median imputation.
rolling_distribution.compute: O(n*w), under 1 MB for this series.

seasonal_residual.mechanism: Recent deviations from the point-in-time same-weekday capacity proxy.
seasonal_residual.leakage: Current-day residual is shifted before use.
seasonal_residual.missing: Fold-fitted median imputation or zero in fixed rule.

trend_regime.mechanism: Detect persistent level shift/change relative to longer context.
trend_regime.leakage: No centered windows or future change points.
